purpose: Market-independent high-class historical ability model for comparison with M3. Estimates result-strength from strictly prior 3-win-or-higher starts; does not use odds, popularity, PCI/RPCI, position, current scenario, or current market.
universe: JRA flat, field_size>=12, 3-win class or higher

protocol.selection: Predefined feature sets and L2 LogisticRegression C grid; 5-fold GroupKFold by race on 2024. Selected full feature set, C=0.03 by top3 log loss.
protocol.runtime_history: up to 5 strictly prior 3-win-or-higher flat starts
protocol.race_coherence: Common logit shift within each race so Ability top3 probabilities sum to exactly 3.0.

feature_definitions.hist_n: Number of strictly prior 3-win+ starts available, capped at 5.
feature_definitions.mean3_finish_pct: Mean normalized finish percentile over last up to 3 prior 3-win+ starts.
feature_definitions.mean5_finish_pct: Mean normalized finish percentile over last up to 5 prior 3-win+ starts.
feature_definitions.best5_finish_pct: Best normalized finish percentile over last up to 5 prior 3-win+ starts.
feature_definitions.top3_rate5: Top-3 rate over last up to 5 prior 3-win+ starts.
feature_definitions.win_rate5: Win rate over last up to 5 prior 3-win+ starts.
feature_definitions.mean_class5: Mean class level over last up to 5 prior starts.
feature_definitions.max_class5: Highest class level over last up to 5 prior starts.
feature_definitions.mean_margin5: Mean official finish margin over last up to 5 prior starts, clipped to [-1,5] seconds.
feature_definitions.best_margin5: Best official finish margin over last up to 5 prior starts, clipped to [-1,5] seconds.
feature_definitions.last1_margin: Previous-start official finish margin, clipped to [-1,5] seconds.
feature_definitions.finish_trend: Mean finish percentile of most recent 2 minus earlier starts among the last 5; missing unless >=4 starts.

display.ability_rank: Rank by raw model logit within current race; higher logit is stronger.
display.ability_index: 50 + 10 * within-race z-score(raw model logit). This is a relative index, not a probability.
display.ability_top3: Projected model top3 probability after race-coherent common-logit shift. This is a history-only structural probability, not market value.

caveats: Ability v1 is a latent historical result-strength estimate, not an observable true ability.
It intentionally excludes market and M3 inputs so it can be compared with them independently.
It uses only prior 3-win+ starts. Horses with little or no high-class history are shrunk toward the model baseline and should be shown as history-limited.
Do not average Ability probability with M3 or market probability without a separately frozen OOS combiner.
Ability Index is race-relative; compare within the current race, not across unrelated races.
